name: Sunbeam

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

sustain.label: Sunbeam
sustain.help: A Magic action: a new 60-ft beam (Con save, 6d8 Radiant, half on a success).

summary: A 60-foot line of sunlight: Con save or 6d8 Radiant and Blinded until the start of your next turn; half damage only on a success.
text: You can fire a new beam as a Magic action on later turns. While the spell lasts you shed sunlight: Bright Light in a 30-ft radius and Dim Light 30 ft beyond.
